learning_objective: 🎯 Become a master navigator by using cool grids, finding hidden coordinates, and plotting awesome routes!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A grid is a map covered in horizontal and vertical lines that make little squares. It helps us pinpoint exactly where a place is hiding!
Coordinates are secret math addresses! If the treasure is at (B, 3), we move right to column B and go up to row 3 to find it.
By moving step-by-step along the grid lines, we can plan the shortest and safest route from our home to the magical park.

fun_activity.title: 🎯 Secret Treasure Grid
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a small grid on paper. Hide a tiny coin on one square, and tell your friend the secret coordinates (like C, 4) so they can find it!

quick_recap: ⭐ A grid is a pattern of straight lines crossing each other to form squares.
⭐ Coordinates use a letter and a number to give every spot an exact address.
⭐ Grids make it super easy to describe locations and plan travel routes!
